items.quote: 8:6 And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
items.claim: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ark he had built.

items.quote: 8:7 And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
items.claim: Noah sent out a raven, which flew back and forth until the waters had dried up from the earth.
